basic.name: Shuriken (Q)
basic.description: Throw 3 Shuriken in a spread pattern, each dealing 65 damage to the first enemy hit. Stores up to 3 charges. Shuriken's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time. {highlight}After hitting 60 heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken{/highlight}

basic.name: Deflect (W)
basic.description: Channel for 1.25 seconds, becoming Protected and blocking damage. Any damage blocked while channeling causes Genji to throw a Kunai toward the nearest enemy, prioritizing Heroes and dealing 55 damage. Total Damage Deflected: 1" Precision="0"/>

basic.name: Swift Strike (E)
basic.description: Dash forward, dealing 190 damage to all enemies in a line. Enemy Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit with Swift Strike cause the cooldown and mana cost to be refunded.

heroic.name: Dragonblade (R)
heroic.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 damage.

heroic.name: X-Strike (R)
heroic.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145 damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 damage to enemies in their area.

trait.name: Cyber Agility (T)
trait.description: Activate to jump to the target area.

general.name: Base
general.description: Writing 'Ryujin no ken wo kurae' on chat will write 'The dragon needs healing'.

1.name: Cyber Ninja
1.description: {highlight}While mounted increase the range of Cyber Agility by 70%{/highlight}. Using Cyber Agility grants {highlight}35{/highlight} Spell Armor for {highlight}3{/highlight} seconds.
passives: Genji dodges 1 Heroic Basic Attack every {highlight}8{/highlight} seconds.
1.developerCommentary: A individually strong talent but one who became toxic when paired with Pathfinder cooldown reduction. The objective here is to prevent talent combos that reset Cyber Agility. It's arguable an absurd talent on level 1 on the hands of people which know to play but Genji is also affected by his team as a character that provides almost no PVE help..what i mean is that this talent is fun but will only be abused on high elo lobbies which i don't mind as a rotation killer and also a talent with three different numeric effects can be number nerfed on three differente places.

1.name: Swift as the Wind
1.description: {highlight}Cyber Agility can be recast two times within a period of 5 seconds. Genji becomes Unstopabble while jumping{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I wanted to make this talent tier about Cyber Agility and for that reason my reasoning was to make something that could be more Dragonblade oriented and Cool ninja stuff as my objective is not just fill Genji gaps but rather give him more funny stuff to do.

1.name: Pathfinder
1.description: Jumping over terrain with Cyber Agility increases Movement Speed by 25%, and grants Stealth, for 4 seconds. {highlight}While Stealth increases Cyber Agility refresh rate by 1000%{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: With the changes on the other talents from that tier i want to bring that talent closer to rotation purposes but not so eazy to abuse the cooldown on teamfights by attaching it to Stealth. And besides this is NIN-NIN roleplay.
subtexts: If i did math right, it's supposed to be a 2 second cooldown
Receiving Stealth from other sources will also increase the refresh rate

4.name: Strike At The Heart
4.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 134 damage after 1 second. {highlight}Increase Swift Strike range by 1{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: As a talent that works for the tip i would argue that it could perform again like the old times.

4.name: Dragon Claw
4.description: After Genji blocks 330 damage with Deflect, activate to release a Dragon Claw, dealing 190 damage to all nearby enemies.

4.name: Sharpened Stars
4.description: Shuriken now pierce all enemies hit.
4.developerCommentary: With the way i want to apply Genji the Shuriken reset would need to be baseline

7.name: Augmented Guard
7.description: When Deflect ends, Genji gains a Shield equal to 100% of the damage blocked for 4 seconds.

7.name: Perfect Defense
7.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

7.name: Reflect
7.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.
7.developerCommentary: Changing this tier to be about Deflect

13.name: Shingan
13.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 115 bonus damage.

13.name: Flow Like Water
13.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Swift Strike reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

13.name: Way Of The Shimada
13.description: Increase Genji's Basic Attack range by 1. Each time Genji hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase his Basic Attack damage by 1% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 15%.

16.name: Dragon Steel
16.description: {highlight}Hitting an enemy hero with Swift Strike increase Genji movement speed by 30% and grants a 360 shield for 3 seconds.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: The objective here is to make a safe option to this tier if you wish to go with a Dragonblade build on

16.name: Final Cut
16.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 125 damage to all enemies in the area.

16.name: Steady Blade
16.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Swift Strike increases the damage of the next Swift Strike by 30%. This bonus stacks up to 3 times. {highlight} Grants 0.25 seconds of unrevealable stealth for each stack. {/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: I want to give this talent an appeal without buffing the damage as it leads to conflicts with Final Cut as a stat damage competitor with that in mind i want to make it pickable for another reason.

20.name: The Dragon Becomes Me
20.description: Each time Dragonblade hits an enemy Hero, the duration of Dragonblade is increased by 0.5 seconds. If a Hero is killed within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Dragonblade, Swift Strike's cooldown is reset.

20.name: Living Weapon
20.description: Each enemy Hero hit by X-Strike reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

20.name: Ninja Course
20.description: {highlight}Cyber Agility creates caltrops trap area where he lands that lasts 2.5 seconds and deals 65 damage per second on enemies in the area and reduces their armor by 5 for 4 seconds, up to 20{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: I really wanted to give either give smoke bomb or a caltrops ninja trap because Genji is a ninja and ninja things are cool. I wouldn't give him smoke bomb because i alredy implemented smoke bombs similars on Pathfinder and Steady Blade.
subtexts: Radius is 2 | Malfurion Entangling Roots is 3.0

20.name: Zanshin
20.description: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Block 6500 damage with Deflect, including damage blocked so far. {reward}Reward:{/reward} Deflect hits all nearby enemy Heroes.
